text: 59-year-old female. The patient reports a 1-month history of episodic cough and shortness of breath. The cough is nonproductive and worsens when climbing stairs and at night. She experienced fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-infectious bronchial hyperreactivity / Asthma exacerbation following a recent upper respiratory infection.

The patient describes a 1-month history of episodic, nonproductive cough and shortness of breath that worsens with exertion (climbing stairs) and at night, following fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago. This presentation is highly suggestive of reactive airway disease triggered by a prior viral infection. I will request a Chest_XRay to rule out underlying pneumonia or other structural abnormalities before finalizing the plan.
